speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; seven months of auditory hallucinations with mocking voices is concerning for psychosis rather than a migraine. speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia. The clinical picture of a 7-month history of persistent, mocking auditory hallucinations, combined with a normal brain MRI and no evidence of major mood episodes or mania, strongly supports this primary psychotic disorder diagnosis.
